stem:
Which of the following statements is/are correct? Viruses can infect
1. Bacteria 2. Fungi
3. Plants
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
expl: A virus is a small infectious agent that replicates only inside the living cells of other organisms. It can infect all types of life forms, from animals and plants to microorganisms, including bacteria and fungi.

stem: Which one of the following is not correctly matched? Crop Disease
expl: Green hair disease is found in bajra. The symptom of green hair disease is the hairs of bajra becomes twisted. Green leaves and the hairs of bajra seems like a broom, as a result the plants remains dwarf. Rest of the options are correctly matched.

stem: Which one of the following is not correctly matched? Crop Disease
expl: Wilting occurs when leaves and other delicate aerial components of plant lose their turgidity, producing drooping, folding and rolling. It is mainly a disease of gram, chick pea, sugarcane, toor, etc. It is not a disease of paddy. Other pairs are correctly matched.

stem: Deficiency of which of the following elements causes yellowing and poor growth of the plants?
expl: Nitrogen is essential for chlorophyll synthesis and protein formation. In its absence, leaves begin to turn yellow first from the older parts (Uniform Chlorosis) and the whole plant remains dwarf-like (stunted growth).

stem: Which element deficiency causes chlorosis in maize plant?
expl: ‘Zn’ (Zinc) is a micronutrient element which is required in little quantity by plants. Due to deficiency of Zn, chlorosis occurs in maize plants in which leaves of plants are undeveloped and plants become dwarf. The tip of maize leaves get white and they are mottled and yellow because of Zn deficiency.

stem: White Bud disease in plant is caused by deficiency of
expl: Name given to Zinc (Zn) deficiency include khaira disease of rice, white bud of maize, mottle leaf (little leaf) or frenching of citrus and cotton.

stem: Pyrilla is pest of which crop?
expl: Pyrilla is leafhopper which sucks up leaves and plant sap of sugarcane. Under low infestation, yellow patches appear on the leaves that cause yellowing and eventually drying of leaves. That’s why sugarcane crop growth disrupted. This insect is very harmful to sugarcane.

stem: The deadly disease of groundnut is :
expl: Tikka is a major disease affecting groundnut (and all its variety) in India. It occurs as well in almost all groundnut-growing countries of the world. It occurs as two distinct types of leaf spot, namely, early leaf spot and late leaf spot. These are caused by pathogenic fungus Cercospora personata and Cercospora arachidicola.

stem: White rust is prominent fungal disease of –
expl: White rust is a prominent fungal disease of mustard which spread by fungi Albugo candida. White lecions/patches appear on the stem, leaves and inflorescence of the plant, as a result the capacity of plant reduced. Fungicide should be used for the treatment of white rust.

stem: Rice blast disease is a ____ disease.
expl: The rice blast disease is caused by an ascomycetes fungus named Pyricularia oryzae or Magnaporthe oryzae (Magnaporthe grisea). It can affect all above ground parts of a rice plant : leaf, collar, node, neck, parts of panicle, and sometimes leaf sheat. It is one of the most destructive diseases of rice. Rice blast causes economically significant crop loss annually worldwide.

stem: Which among the following statements is not true?

options.label: a
options.text: Rust is a disease found in wheat.

options.label: b
options.text: Early blight is a disease found in potato.

options.label: c
options.text: False smut is a disease found in barley.

options.label: d
options.text: Khaira is a disease found in paddy.

expl: False smut is a disease found in paddy (not in barley). It causes chalkiness of grains which leads to reduction in grain weight. It also reduces seed germination. Statements of other three options are correct.

stem: Two common fungal diseases of wheat are :
expl: Two common fungal diseases of the wheat crop are black rust and loose smut. Black rust of wheat is caused by Puccinia graminis tritici and loose smut of wheat is caused by Ustilago nuda tritici.

stem: Karnal Bunt is a disease of :
expl: Karnal Bunt is a fungal disease caused by the smut fungus Tilletia indica. It affects the quality of wheat. It was first reported in 1931, infecting wheat growing near the city of Karnal, Haryana.

stem: Tungro virus of rice is spread by –
expl: Tungro is a disease of rice found in South-East Asia. The cause of disease are two group of virus : (1) RTSV : Rice Tungro Spherical Virus (2) RTBV : Rice Tungro Bacilliform Virus Both are transmitted together by green leafhoppers.

stem:
Consider the following :
1. Birds 2. Dust blowing
3. Rain 4. Wind blowing
Which of the above spread plant diseases?
expl: Plant Pathology (also Phytopathology) is the scientific study of plant diseases caused by pathogens like viruses, bacteria, fungi etc. and environmental conditions (physiological factors). The dissemination factors of these include – wind, rain, animals, soil, nursery graft, contaminated equipment and tools, infected seed stock, pollen, dust storm, irrigation water, birds and humans.

stem: What causes ‘Blackheart’ in potato ?
expl: Blackheart is an abiotic disease which is caused due to low availability of oxygen during storage of potato.

stem: Yellow vein mosaic disease in okra, caused by :
expl: Yellow vein mosaic disease in okra is a viral disease. Whitefly is a factor of this virus.

stem: ‘Yellow Vein Mosaic’ is a serious disease of :
expl: Yellow vein mosaic disease in okra is a viral disease. Whitefly is a factor of this virus.

stem: ‘Spongy Tissue’ is a serious disorder hampering the export of mango variety. It is –
expl: The spongy tissue, a ripening disorder is often described as soft centre white corky tissue or internal breakdown in Alphonso mangoes. This disorder is peculiar to South India only.
